  <meta name="standalone-build" content="true"><style id="collectives-storytelling-v2">

/* The Collectives | Connected storytelling expansion.
   Isolated selectors retain existing branding, layout, and Framer Motion animation. */
.cc-host { --cc-blue:#1e58ff; --cc-green:#00c4a7; --cc-yellow:#ffc107; --cc-ink:#0e1117; --cc-rule:rgba(255,255,255,.13); color:#f8f9fd; position:relative; isolation:isolate; }
.cc-host * { box-sizing:border-box; }
.cc-host button, .cc-host a { -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; }
.cc-host button:focus-visible,.cc-host a:focus-visible,.cc-host summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f8f9fd; outline-offset:5px; }
.cc-host .cc-section { position:relative; padding:110px clamp(22px,6.25vw,110px) 120px; overflow:hidden; border-top:1px solid var(--cc-rule); scroll-margin-top:80px; }
.cc-host .cc-section:before {content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:.28; background:linear-gradient(90deg, #fff 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 85px 85px,linear-gradient(#fff 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 85px 85px; mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 28%, transparent 95%); background-image:linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff0d 1px, transparent 1px),linear-gradient(#ffffff0d 1px, transparent 1px);}
.cc-host .cc-section > * { position:relative; z-index:1; }
.cc-host h2,.cc-host h3,.cc-host p {margin:0;}
.cc-host h2 {font-size:clamp(47px,6.2vw,102px);line-height:.99;letter-spacing:-.055em;font-weight:650; text-wrap:balance;}
.cc-host h2 em {font-style:normal;color:#a6afbe;}
.cc-host h2 span {color:#fff;}
.cc-host .cc-eyebrow {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;color:#b3bfd0;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;margin-bottom:38px;}
.cc-host .cc-dot {width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cc-green);box-shadow:0 0 19px #00c4a766;flex:0 0 auto;}
.cc-host .cc-rule {height:1px;background:#ffffff29;width:60px;display:inline-block;}
.cc-host .cc-reveal {opacity:1;transform:none;}
.cc-host.cc-motion-ready .cc-reveal {opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .72s ease,transform .72s cubic-bezier(.2,.76,.22,1);}
.cc-host.cc-motion-ready .cc-reveal.cc-is-visible {opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.cc-challenge {background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 16% 100%,#1e58ff1b,transparent 45%),#0b0e14;}
.cc-challenge-header {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr .5fr;gap:clamp(35px,6vw,100px);align-items:end;max-width:1420px;}
.cc-challenge-header h2 {max-width:15ch;font-size:clamp(45px,5.6vw,86px);}
.cc-challenge-header h2 em {color:#fff; text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--cc-yellow);text-decoration-thickness:3px;text-underline-offset:12px;}
.cc-challenge-header h2 span {color:#afbbce;}
.cc-challenge-header > p {font-size:clamp(16px,1.35vw,19px);line-height:1.7;color:#b4becd;max-width:390px;}
.cc-challenge-grid {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px;margin-top:75px;}
.cc-challenge-card {display:flex; flex-direction:column;align-items:start; min-height:430px; padding:clamp(24px,2.55vw,40px);border:1px solid #ffffff16;border-top:2px solid var(--cc-card);background:linear-gradient(156deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc-card) 11%,#10131a),#11151d 48%,#0c1016);border-radius:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden; transition:transform .35s ease,border-color .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease;}
.cc-challenge-card:before {content:"";position:absolute;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc-card) 28%,transparent);border-radius:50%;width:250px;height:250px;right:-110px;top:-140px;pointer-events:none;}
.cc-challenge-card:hover {border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc-card) 52%,transparent);box-shadow:0 20px 60px #0000002e;transform:translateY(-6px);}
.cc-icon-box {width:51px;height:51px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:13px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc-card) 15%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc-card) 35%,transparent);color:var(--cc-card);}
.cc-index {font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#9eabba;font-weight:650;margin-top:37px;}
.cc-challenge-card h3 {font-size:clamp(25px,2.5vw,38px);font-weight:620;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.1;margin:15px 0 19px;}
.cc-challenge-card p {color:#b7c0ce;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;max-width:350px;margin:0 0 33px;}
.cc-challenge-card button {margin-top:auto;color:#f5f7fb;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;background:transparent;display:inline-flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--cc-card);}
.cc-challenge-card button svg {width:16px;height:16px;transition:transform .2s ease;}
.cc-challenge-card button:hover svg {transform:translate(3px,-3px);}
.cc-challenge-tail {border-top:1px solid #ffffff21;padding-top:25px;margin-top:33px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.cc-tail-orbs {display:inline-flex;padding-left:10px;flex:0 0 auto;}
.cc-tail-orbs b {width:25px;height:25px;margin-left:-8px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #0b0e14;background:#1e58ff;}
.cc-tail-orbs b:nth-child(2){background:#00c4a7;}.cc-tail-orbs b:nth-child(3){background:#ffc107;}
.cc-challenge-tail p {color:#bec7d6;font-size:13px;flex:1 1 320px;line-height:1.7;}
.cc-challenge-tail strong {color:#fff;}
.cc-challenge-tail a,.cc-workflow-foot a,.cc-portfolio-header a {color:#fff;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;white-space:nowrap;}
.cc-challenge-tail a svg,.cc-workflow-foot a svg,.cc-portfolio-header a svg {width:17px;height:17px;transition:translate .25s ease;}
.cc-challenge-tail a:hover svg,.cc-workflow-foot a:hover svg,.cc-portfolio-header a:hover svg {translate:4px 0;}
.cc-workflow {background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 82% 44%,#00c4a716,transparent 48%),#090d13;}
.cc-workflow-head {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .65fr;align-items:end;gap:60px;max-width:1370px;margin-bottom:65px;}
.cc-workflow-head h2 {max-width:11ch;}
.cc-workflow-head h2 span {color:var(--cc-green);}
.cc-workflow-head p {font-size:clamp(16px,1.3vw,19px);color:#b9c3cf;line-height:1.75;max-width:500px;}
.cc-workflow-surface {border:1px solid #ffffff25;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#121923,#0d1119 80%);border-radius:24px;min-height:560px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:.67fr .9fr 1.2fr;box-shadow:0 28px 120px #0007;overflow:hidden;position:relative;}
.cc-workflow-orbit {display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:30px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 46%,#1e58ff16,transparent 60%),#0a1018;position:relative;min-height:470px;border-right:1px solid #ffffff1b;overflow:hidden;}
.cc-workflow-orbit:before,.cc-workflow-orbit:after {content:"";border:1px solid #ffffff1e;border-radius:50%;position:absolute;aspect-ratio:1;width:260px;max-width:100%;}
.cc-workflow-orbit:after {width:190px;border-style:dashed;animation:cc-spin 45s linear infinite;}
.cc-workflow-arc {position:absolute;width:230px;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid transparent;border-top-color:var(--cc-green);border-left-color:var(--cc-blue);border-right-color:var(--cc-yellow);animation:cc-spin 26s linear infinite;}
.cc-workflow-beacon {width:8px;height:8px;position:absolute;top:calc(50% - 104px);left:calc(50% - 4px);background:var(--cc-green);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 28px var(--cc-green);animation:cc-glow 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;}
.cc-mini-logo {position:relative;height:112px;width:112px;margin-top:-12px;z-index:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 22px #0008)}
.cc-mini-logo i {position:absolute;width:61px;height:61px;border-radius:50%;border:13px solid;}
.cc-mini-logo i:nth-child(1){border-color:var(--cc-blue);left:8px;top:11px;}.cc-mini-logo i:nth-child(2){border-color:var(--cc-yellow);right:8px;top:11px;}.cc-mini-logo i:nth-child(3){border-color:var(--cc-green);left:26px;bottom:5px;}
.cc-orbit-caption {color:#91a1b4;letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:10px;line-height:1.9;text-align:center;z-index:2;}
.cc-workflow-ui {border-right:1px solid #ffffff1b;padding:45px 23px;}
.cc-workflow-kicker {color:#e2e7ef;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:10px;font-weight:650;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin-bottom:37px!important;}
.cc-workflow-kicker span {color:#7e90a3;font-size:9px;}
.cc-workflow-tabs {display:grid;gap:11px;}
.cc-workflow-tab {--tab-color:#fff;width:100%;text-align:left;min-height:99px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;background:#161e28;color:#e8edf4;border:1px solid #ffffff1a;border-radius:13px;padding:15px 17px;position:relative;transition:background .28s ease,border-color .28s ease,transform .28s ease;}
.cc-workflow-tab:hover {background:#1c2734;}
.cc-workflow-tab[aria-selected="true"] {background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tab-color) 12%,#18202a);border-color:var(--tab-color);transform:translateX(5px);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--tab-color);}
.cc-tab-index {font-size:10px;color:#95a0b2;align-self:flex-start;}
.cc-tab-icon {width:40px;height:40px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tab-color) 35%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tab-color) 10%,transparent);color:var(--tab-color);flex:0 0 40px;}
.cc-tab-icon svg{width:19px;height:19px;}.cc-tab-label{display:grid;gap:4px;flex:1;}.cc-tab-label strong{letter-spacing:.07em;font-size:14px;}.cc-tab-label small{font-size:10px;color:#a0adbb;}
.cc-tab-arrow svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:#a1aabb;}.cc-workflow-tab[aria-selected="true"] .cc-tab-arrow{color:#fff;}
.cc-workflow-detail {padding:43px clamp(25px,3.5vw,60px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.cc-detail-caption {font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#9eacbc;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff20;padding:0 0 24px;}
.cc-detail-caption>span:last-child{margin-left:auto;color:#677688;}.cc-live-indicator{background:var(--cc-green);width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 12px #00c4a7;}
.cc-workflow-panel {animation:cc-slide .38s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1) both;}.cc-workflow-panel[hidden]{display:none!important;}
.cc-workflow-super {letter-spacing:.13em;color:#95a5ba;font-size:10px;margin:35px 0 18px!important;}
.cc-workflow-super span{color:var(--cc-green);padding:0 4px;}
.cc-workflow-panel h3 {font-size:clamp(34px,3.5vw,53px);letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:1.04;max-width:420px;margin:0 0 20px;}
.cc-workflow-panel>p:not(.cc-workflow-super) {font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#b5c3d2;max-width:400px;}
.cc-workflow-panel ul{padding:28px 0;margin:25px 0 18px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff1b;display:grid;gap:15px;}
.cc-workflow-panel li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;color:#dfebf4;font-size:13px;}
.cc-workflow-panel li svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--cc-green);flex:0 0 auto;}
.cc-workflow-panel>a{margin-top:auto;border:1px solid #ffffff3c;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;color:#fff;min-height:49px;border-radius:100px;padding:12px 19px;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;}
.cc-workflow-panel>a:hover{background:#ffffff16;}.cc-workflow-panel>a svg{width:18px;height:18px;}
.cc-workflow-foot {display:flex;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:28px!important;color:#9daaba;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;}
.cc-portfolio {background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 0 50%,#ffc10710,transparent 40%),#0c1016;}
.cc-portfolio-header {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .6fr;gap:clamp(40px,7vw,100px);align-items:end;margin-bottom:61px;}
.cc-portfolio-header h2 em {color:var(--cc-yellow);font-style:normal;}
.cc-portfolio-header p {font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;color:#b5c0cd;max-width:455px;margin-bottom:26px;}
.cc-portfolio-grid {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:19px;}
.cc-project{border:1px solid #ffffff1f;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#11171e;transition:translate .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;}
.cc-project:hover{translate:0 -6px;border-color:#ffffff4a;}
.cc-project-visual {height:270px;padding:21px 23px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;}
.cc-project-topline{color:#ffffffc8;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:700;z-index:2;}
.cc-project-art{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;z-index:-1;}
.cc-project-shape{position:absolute;display:block;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,.7,.18,1);}
.cc-project:hover .cc-shape-a{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.06)}.cc-project:hover .cc-shape-b{transform:translate(-12px,12px) rotate(6deg)}
.cc-project-wordmark{display:grid;gap:9px;z-index:2;}
.cc-project-wordmark strong{font-size:clamp(36px,3.5vw,55px);letter-spacing:-.075em;line-height:.95;}
.cc-project-wordmark span{font-size:10px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.cc-project-info{padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:237px;}
.cc-project-metadata{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.075em;color:#9aabb9;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:650;}
.cc-project-status {color:#cbd4de;background:#ffffff12;border:1px solid #ffffff21;border-radius:100px;padding:6px 9px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:0;}
.cc-project-info h3 {font-size:25px;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:18px 0 8px;}
.cc-project-info p {font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:#aebbc8;flex:1;}
.cc-project-info>a{font-size:12px;font-weight:650;color:#f8faff;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;align-self:flex-start;margin-top:28px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff45;}
.cc-project-info>a svg{width:16px;height:16px;transition:translate .2s ease;}.cc-project-info>a:hover svg{translate:3px -3px;}
.cc-project-balay .cc-project-visual{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#132e21,#235b42 80%);}.cc-project-balay .cc-shape-a{width:260px;height:260px;border:30px solid #9ed4a9;border-radius:50%;right:-130px;top:20px;opacity:.68;}.cc-project-balay .cc-shape-b{width:115px;height:170px;background:#bee7bf;transform:rotate(23deg);right:60px;top:6px;border-radius:12px;opacity:.24;}
.cc-project-pallo .cc-project-visual{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#292344,#614bae);}.cc-project-pallo .cc-shape-a{width:240px;height:240px;border-radius:50%;border:30px solid #d0f272;right:-70px;top:50px;}.cc-project-pallo .cc-shape-b{width:300px;height:3px;background:#ffffffa8;transform:rotate(-35deg);right:-80px;top:80px;}
.cc-project-melo .cc-project-visual{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#201b3e,#6440ad 70%,#316fe0);}.cc-project-melo .cc-shape-a{width:190px;height:190px;border-radius:38px;transform:rotate(-20deg);right:-40px;top:25px;background:#c2acf4;opacity:.34;}.cc-project-melo .cc-shape-b{width:95px;height:95px;border:18px solid #dcd2ff;border-radius:32px;right:90px;top:65px;transform:rotate(27deg);opacity:.75;}
.cc-project-dingo .cc-project-visual{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fbb525,#f47735);color:#251926;}.cc-project-dingo .cc-project-topline{color:#3d2633;}.cc-project-dingo .cc-shape-a{width:230px;height:230px;border-radius:56px;transform:rotate(27deg);background:#f33b79;right:-90px;top:25px;}.cc-project-dingo .cc-shape-b{width:90px;height:90px;border-radius:50%;background:#40204b;right:120px;top:74px;}
.cc-project-tatayo .cc-project-visual{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f4e4ba,#d09a60);color:#3c352c;}.cc-project-tatayo .cc-project-topline{color:#473a2e;}.cc-project-tatayo .cc-shape-a{width:250px;height:270px;border-radius:130px 130px 0 0;transform:rotate(-10deg);background:#5f533a;right:-95px;top:50px;opacity:.78;}.cc-project-tatayo .cc-shape-b{width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;background:#f5d9a5;right:70px;top:25px;}
.cc-project-justsigned .cc-project-visual{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#e9dacf,#b99e9b);color:#4e3339;}.cc-project-justsigned .cc-project-topline{color:#684b50;}.cc-project-justsigned .cc-shape-a{width:230px;height:200px;border-radius:15px;background:#fff4e7;right:-35px;top:42px;transform:rotate(-14deg);box-shadow:0 15px 35px #54333633;}.cc-project-justsigned .cc-shape-b{width:170px;height:140px;border-radius:8px;background:#a97778;right:50px;top:4px;transform:rotate(17deg);}
.cc-portfolio-note{font-size:12px;color:#8fa1b2;line-height:1.6;max-width:750px;margin-top:32px!important;}
.cc-faq{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 20%,#1e58ff1b,transparent 39%),#0b0f15;display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:clamp(35px,6vw,100px);}
.cc-faq-intro h2{font-size:clamp(48px,5vw,82px);}.cc-faq-intro h2 span{color:var(--cc-yellow);}.cc-faq-intro>p:not(.cc-eyebrow){max-width:380px;color:#aebbc9;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;margin-top:25px;}
.cc-faq-list{border-top:1px solid #ffffff35;}.cc-faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff31;padding:0;}
.cc-faq-item summary{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:37px 1fr 20px;align-items:center;gap:12px;cursor:pointer;padding:27px 7px 27px 0;color:#f5f8fc;font-size:clamp(15px,1.3vw,18px);font-weight:550;line-height:1.4;}
.cc-faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}.cc-faq-num{color:#8c9bae;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;}.cc-faq-plus{height:18px;width:18px;position:relative;}.cc-faq-plus:before,.cc-faq-plus:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:13px;height:1px;background:#f6f9fd;left:2px;top:8px;transition:transform .25s ease;}.cc-faq-plus:after{transform:rotate(90deg)}.cc-faq-item[open] .cc-faq-plus:after{transform:rotate(0)}
.cc-faq-item>p{max-width:680px;color:#aebdcd;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;padding:0 45px 27px 49px;}
.cc-faq-item[open] summary{color:#fff;}
@keyframes cc-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes cc-glow{50%{box-shadow:0 0 35px #00c4a7;opacity:.55;}}@keyframes cc-slide{from{opacity:.45;transform:translateY(13px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media(max-width:1180px){.cc-workflow-surface{grid-template-columns:.65fr 1.1fr;}.cc-workflow-orbit{display:none;}.cc-portfolio-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));}.cc-faq{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr;}}
@media(max-width:800px){.cc-host .cc-section{padding:76px 22px 90px;}.cc-host .cc-eyebrow{margin-bottom:28px;font-size:9px;}.cc-host h2{font-size:clamp(43px,9vw,72px);}.cc-challenge-header,.cc-workflow-head,.cc-portfolio-header,.cc-faq{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:25px;}.cc-challenge-header h2{font-size:clamp(43px,8vw,70px);}.cc-challenge-header>p,.cc-workflow-head p{max-width:620px;}.cc-challenge-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:11px;margin-top:39px;}.cc-challenge-card{min-height:0;padding:26px;}.cc-index{margin-top:22px;}.cc-challenge-card h3 br{display:none;}.cc-challenge-card p{margin-bottom:20px;}.cc-workflow-head{margin-bottom:35px;}.cc-workflow-surface{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.cc-workflow-ui{padding:24px 18px 19px;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff25;}.cc-workflow-tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}.cc-workflow-tab{min-height:130px;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 9px;}.cc-workflow-tab[aria-selected="true"]{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:inset 0 3px var(--tab-color);}.cc-tab-index,.cc-tab-arrow,.cc-tab-label small{display:none;}.cc-tab-label strong{font-size:11px;}.cc-tab-icon{width:37px;height:37px;flex-basis:37px;}.cc-workflow-detail{padding:25px 24px 32px;min-height:420px;}.cc-workflow-panel h3{font-size:37px;}.cc-portfolio-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;}.cc-project-visual{height:235px;}.cc-project-info{min-height:255px;}.cc-faq-intro{max-width:600px;}.cc-faq-list{margin-top:12px;}}
@media(max-width:550px){.cc-workflow-tab{min-height:105px;}.cc-tab-label strong{font-size:10px;}.cc-workflow-kicker{font-size:9px;}.cc-workflow-kicker span{display:none;}.cc-portfolio-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.cc-project-visual{height:275px;}.cc-project-info{min-height:0;}.cc-project-info p{min-height:44px;}.cc-challenge-tail{gap:12px;}.cc-host .cc-rule{width:22px;}.cc-faq-item summary{grid-template-columns:29px 1fr 18px;gap:8px;}.cc-faq-item>p{padding-left:37px;padding-right:13px;}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cc-host .cc-reveal,.cc-host.cc-motion-ready .cc-reveal{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;transition:none!important;}.cc-host *, .cc-host *:before,.cc-host *:after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important;}}

.cc-official-mark{width:clamp(110px,13vw,180px);height:auto;position:relative;z-index:2;filter:drop-shadow(0 16px 28px #0007);transition:transform .65s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1)}.cc-workflow-orbit:hover .cc-official-mark{transform:translateY(-8px) rotate(-5deg)}

</style>
<style id="cc-cosmos-brand-adaptation">
/* The Collectives | Globe background integration, October 2026.
   Preserve existing three-collective brand system and all component markup. */
html { background:#05070c; }
#cc-space-wrap { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0; overflow:hidden; pointer-events:none; background:#05070c; }
#cc-cosmos, #cc-space-markers { display:block;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none; }
#cc-cosmos { opacity:1; }
#cc-space-markers { z-index:2; }
#root { position:relative; z-index:1; isolation:isolate; }
.universe-background { background:transparent !important; }
.universe-background .particle-field { opacity:.22; }
.universe-background .solar-light { opacity:.19; right:-15vw; }
.universe-background .ambient-mark { opacity:.018; }
/* Globe is visible behind the brand story, never in front of content. */
.hero { background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 81% 29%,#1e58ff20,transparent 46%), rgba(5,7,12,.08); }
.hero:after { background:linear-gradient(90deg,#05070cce 0%,#05070c8a 37%,#05070c27 68%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,#05070cf4,transparent 29%); }
.brand-philosophy { background:radial-gradient(circle at 74% 47%,#1e58ff0c,transparent 46%),#0e111791; }
.separation { background:#0e11177f; }
.collectives-row { background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0e1117de,#0e11178a 50%,#0e1117eb); }
.process { background:#0e11178d; }
.principles { background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 75%,#00c4a709,transparent 39%),#0e111799; }
.contact-section { background:radial-gradient(circle at 10% 35%,#1e58ff16,transparent 26%),#0e1117c9; }
.cc-challenge { background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 16% 90%,#1e58ff12,transparent 46%),#0b0e14ae; }
.cc-workflow { background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 82% 44%,#00c4a714,transparent 50%),#090d13ab; }
.cc-faq { background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 20%,#1e58ff13,transparent 39%),#0b0f15cc; }
.cc-portfolio { background-color:#080c12b3; }
/* Preserve strong contrast for interactive content, buttons, and cards. */
.cc-workflow-surface,.cc-challenge-card,.cc-project,.inquiry-form { -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);backdrop-filter:blur(8px); }
@media(max-width:799px){
  .hero{background:rgba(5,7,12,.14);}
  .hero:after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#05070c5f 0%,#05070c52 38%,#05070cde 72%,#05070cef 100%);}
  .brand-philosophy,.process,.principles{background:#0e1117c0;}
  .cc-challenge,.cc-workflow,.cc-faq{background:#0b0f15ca;}
  .universe-background .solar-light{opacity:.11;}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #cc-cosmos,#cc-space-markers{animation:none;}
}

</style>
</head>
  <body>
    <noscript>
      <main class="noscript-shell">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64,
